concepts.title: 胆小菇外观
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: 3D cartoon enemy appearance reference.
Primary request: faithfully depict Scaredy-shroom (胆小菇) from the ORIGINAL 2009 Plants vs. Zombies as a clean simple 3D cartoon character. The user specifically wants that familiar mushroom appearance, not a new alien interpretation or a generic fat mushroom. Keep its recognizable original proportions, cap, face and timid personality.
Subject: one Scaredy-shroom in its normal extended above-ground pose, with a slender elongated pale green mushroom stalk, a rounded spotted purple mushroom cap, two equally sized large nervous eyes placed normally side by side beneath the cap, and the familiar short forward-projecting tubular spore-shooting mouth. The stalk is thin and fairly upright, slightly wider at the rounded grounded base; the cap is regular and balanced, not a giant collapsing floppy hat. Shy, appealing, readable face. Follow the classic game character's familiar color placement and cap spots rather than redesigning them.
Style/medium: polished simple geometric 3D cartoon render with smooth rounded contours, low-complexity mesh forms, softly beveled edges and broad clean colors; restrained faceting, no messy triangulated surface. Keep the construction simple enough for an actual game asset.
Composition: one complete character, large front three-quarter view, whole cap and base visible, plain light warm-gray background, soft studio light and small contact shadow. No scenery.
Constraints: cancel all previous requests for deliberate asymmetry, odd distorted proportions, uncanny ugliness or mismatched eyes. No oversized eyes of different sizes, no off-center face, no lopsided cap, no kinked stalk, no mole traits, no animal fur, no arms, no hands, no human legs or feet, no clothing, no weapons, no pumpkin, no extra creatures, no labels, no text or watermark. This is an appearance study only; do not show multiple animation poses.

concepts.title: 黑圆头幽灵法师
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised 3D cartoon ghost wizard enemy appearance reference.
Input image: the supplied previous cyan ghost wizard is an edit target. Keep ONLY the general lower-tail idea: a suspended ghost body that narrows downward into a gently curving tapered flame-like tail. Redesign its head, upper body, colors and hat according to the user's requirements below. Do not preserve the previous unequal eyes, angular flame face, crooked exaggerated hat, cyan glowing body or deliberate asymmetry.
Primary request: a cute mildly spooky Halloween-like BLACK ghost wizard, without any pumpkins. It has a clearly ROUND near-black head wearing a simple wizard hat, and a separate but connected black ghost body shaped like an inverted flame. The upper body immediately under the head is rounded and full, and the body narrows as it descends toward a wispy curved lower tip, similar to the lower half of the supplied reference.
Subject: one floating little black spirit, with a clean spherical round head, two small equally sized warm ivory glowing oval eyes placed symmetrically, no prominent nose or mouth. The head is the main dark round face volume, not a flame-shaped or humanoid head. It rests directly on a smooth rounded upper body with a soft narrow transition, no long neck. The body resembles a hanging droplet / upside-down cartoon flame, round and plump at the top and smoothly tapering downward into one flowing tail with at most two broad small flame points. No human torso, shoulders or arms. A simple dark charcoal-violet conical wizard hat with a regular round brim and a plain muted purple band sits naturally on the round head. Keep the hat's shape clear and balanced, without a zigzag crooked tip or deliberate off-center distortion.
Color/material: the head AND body must be predominantly deep near-black charcoal, with only restrained dark indigo shading and subtle soft rim light to make the round volumes readable. Eyes are a small light accent. The tail remains black/dark charcoal; any subtle spectral fade is confined to the very tip. The whole body must NOT turn blue, cyan, white or become bright glowing fire.
Style/medium: clean simple geometric cartoon 3D render, appealing rounded volumes, a small number of broad planes with soft shading and bevels, low complexity, no harsh crumpled triangulation, no fine textures or ornament.
Composition: one full character on a plain light warm-gray background, front three-quarter view, complete hat and tail visible, soft separated floor shadow shows floating. Keep a concise readable silhouette.
Constraints: no legs, feet, boots, skirt, robe, human hands, arms, staff, bones, skull face, pumpkin, jack-o'-lantern motifs, orange body, tiny accessories, scenery, text, labels or watermark. No deliberate asymmetry or mismatched eyes. No cyan fire, strong bloom, smoke or particle clutter.
